# 02 — Generated webpack configuration

Generated by `spfx-heft-plugins/lib-commonjs/plugins/webpackConfigurationPlugin/WebpackConfigurationGenerator.js`.
Full dumps (captured with a temporary `config/spfx-customize-webpack.js`, so they include the externals added by `ThirdPartyExternalsPlugin`):
[artifacts/webpack-config-development.json](artifacts/webpack-config-development.json), [-production](artifacts/webpack-config-production.json), [-serve](artifacts/webpack-config-serve.json).

## Entry & output

`config/config.json` (`version 2.0`) → one webpack entry per **bundle**:

```jsonc
"entry": { "hello-world-web-part": {
  "import": "<project>/lib/webparts/helloWorld/HelloWorldWebPart.js",
  "library": { "type": "amd", "name": "2997f152-d79f-45c7-a7d2-ea768b8f5575_0.0.1" } } }
"output": {
  "filename": "[name].js"            // prod & !serve: "[name]_[contenthash].js";  with localization plugin: "[name]_[locale]…"
  "chunkFilename": "chunk.[name].js",
  "libraryTarget": "amd",
  "uniqueName": "<id>_<version>",    // multiple bundles → hash of all ids
  "chunkLoadingGlobal": "webpackJsonp_<id>_<version>",
  "path": "<project>/dist",
  "crossOriginLoading": "anonymous",
  "hashFunction": "md5",
  "devtoolModuleFilenameTemplate": "webpack:///../[resource-path]" }
```

- AMD library **name** = `<manifest.id>_<manifest.version>` (only when there is exactly one component in total; with several components in a bundle the generator writes `temp/bundle-entries/<bundle>.js` with `export * as <var> from '<entry>'` and sets `loaderConfig.exportName` per component).
- Manifest `version: "*"` is replaced with package.json version (pre-release stripped).
- `optimization`: `moduleIds: deterministic`, `sideEffects: true`, `removeEmptyChunks`, `realContentHash: false`, `avoidEntryIife: false`, `usedExports` only in prod. `performance.hints: false`.
- `resolve.extensions: [.wasm .mjs .js .json .css .jsx]`, `modules: [node_modules]`.

The emitted bundle head (dev):

```js
(()=>{ var __RUSHSTACK_CURRENT_SCRIPT__ = document.currentScript;
define("2997f152-d79f-45c7-a7d2-ea768b8f5575_0.0.1",
  ["react","react-dom/client","@microsoft/sp-core-library","@microsoft/sp-property-pane",
   "@microsoft/sp-webpart-base","HelloWorldWebPartStrings","@microsoft/sp-lodash-subset"],
  (__WEBPACK_EXTERNAL_MODULE__959__, …) => { return (() => { /* webpack runtime + modules */ })(); }); })();
```

The entry module exports `default: HelloWorldWebPart` — that is what the page instantiates (see 05).

## Plugins (in order)

| Plugin | Role |
|---|---|
| `SetPublicPathCurrentScriptPlugin` (@rushstack/set-webpack-public-path-plugin) | captures `document.currentScript` at script eval → `__webpack_require__.p = dirname(script.src)`. All assets/chunks are loaded relative to wherever the bundle was actually loaded from (localhost, CDN, ClientSideAssets). |
| `DefinePlugin` | `DEBUG`, `DEPRECATED_UNIT_TEST:false`, `process.env.NODE_ENV` |
| `AsyncComponentPlugin` (SPFx) | rewrites `import('<spfx component>')` into `__webpack_require__.sp(index)` which goes through `SPComponentLoader.loadComponentById` (or sp-core-library's `_getAsyncComponentLoader` fallback); pre-registers components used only by async chunks; removes async‑only externals from the AMD `define` deps |
| `ManifestPlugin` (SPFx) | at `processAssets/REPORT` stage: builds `loaderConfig` from the runtime chunk's external modules, localizes manifest strings (`$path:key;` refs), processes icons, emits `<id>.manifest.json` (debug source; release variant attached), writes dependency audit and `temp/build/manifests.js` |
| `CopyReleaseAssetsPlugin` (SPFx) | at REPORT+1: copies every asset to `release/assets/` and the *release* manifest variant to `release/manifests/` (drops `.map` in prod unless `releaseMapFiles`) |
| `ModuleMinifierPlugin` (prod) | @rushstack module-level terser minification |
| `ServeInfoPlugin` (serve) | prints the debug query string after each compile |
| Localization plugin (only if a localization accessor supplies one — not in this project) | `@rushstack/webpack5-localization-plugin`; produces `[name]_[locale].js` and `localizedPath` manifests |

## Module rules

| Test | Handling |
|---|---|
| `dependency: url` | `asset/resource` |
| `/\.js$/` | `resolve.fullySpecified: false` |
| `/\.module(?:\.scss)?\.css$/i` | `@microsoft/sp-css-loader` with `generateCssClassName` (default: `<class>_<hmac-sha1(filename,css)[0..8]>`) → CSS modules |
| other `.css` | `sp-css-loader` (global) |
| `/\.sprite\.svg$/` | `asset/source` |
| jpg png woff woff2 eot ttf svg gif dds cur webp mp4 zip | `asset/resource`, filename `[name]_[contenthash][ext]` |
| `/\.html$/` | `html-loader` |
| `.js/.css` (dev only, `enforce: pre`) | `source-map-loader` (skips node_modules) — chains Sass `.css.map` into the injected CSS |

### CSS specifics (sp-css-loader)

PostCSS pipeline: `postcss-modules-values/local-by-default/extract-imports/scope`, `autoprefixer`, `cssnano` (calc disabled). Output module:
`loadStyles(<cssString>, true)` from **`@microsoft/load-themed-styles` (bundled, not external)** + `export default { helloWorld: "helloWorld_587db475", … }`.
Theme tokens are authored in SCSS as `color: "[theme:bodyText, default: #323130]"` and are substituted at runtime by load-themed-styles; `var(--bodyText)` fallbacks are kept.

## Externals

Computed in `generateWebpackConfigurationAsync` + `ThirdPartyExternalsPlugin`:

1. **Every npm dependency (deep, sparse) that ships `dist/<guid>.manifest.json`** (`CumulativeManifestProcessor.discoverManifests`, mode `deepSparseIgnoreFirstProject`) — here: sp-core-library, sp-lodash-subset, sp-diagnostics, sp-dynamic-data, sp-page-context, sp-http-base, sp-loader, sp-http-msgraph, sp-http, sp-component-base, sp-image-helper, sp-property-pane, sp-top-actions, sp-webpart-base, sp-office-ui-fabric-core. Assemblies (`rootComponentId`) are not externals.
2. **Non‑standard externals** (`ExternalsProcessor.js`): `react` → `0d910c1c-13b9-4e1c-9aa4-b008c5e42d7d`, `react-dom` → `aa0a46ec-1505-43cd-a44a-93f3a5aa460a`, `react-dom/client` → `3cadd7f5-5449-49c4-a153-1beb8facd90a` (only for React ≥ 18), `@microsoft/microsoft-graph-client` → `32b9363b-09ff-4959-929a-cab2663fb223`. Version = installed package.json version.
3. `config.json` `localizedResources` keys (`HelloWorldWebPartStrings`) and `externals` keys (legacy non-SPFx scripts; `{path, globalName, globalDependencies}` supported → `shim` in RequireJS).
4. Minus `linkedExternalsToBundle` and the project itself; "version‑pinned" externals get a function external.

`tslib` and `@microsoft/load-themed-styles` are **bundled** (not externals) in this project.

Webpack externals are string externals in an AMD library → they become the `define()` dependency array; ManifestPlugin then walks the runtime chunk's `ExternalModule`s and writes one `scriptResources` entry per external (component → `{type:"component",id,version}`, localized resource → `{type:"path", path:"<Name>_<locale>.js"}` + emits that file as an asset, legacy external → `{type:"path", path, globalName?}`).

## Localization (`localizedResources`)

`"HelloWorldWebPartStrings": "lib/webparts/helloWorld/loc/{locale}.js"` → `LegacyExternals` globs files, emits `HelloWorldWebPartStrings_<locale>.js` (prod: `+_<md5>`), and the manifest gets `type:"path"` (one locale) or `type:"localizedPath"` with `paths{locale→file}` + `defaultPath`. The loc file itself is a plain `define([], function(){ return {...} })`.

## Customization points (no eject)

- `config/spfx-customize-webpack.js` — `module.exports = (config, taskSession, heftConfiguration, webpack) => void` (mutate in place). Runs last in `onConfigure`.
- `config/webpack-patch.json` `{ "patchFiles": ["./x.js"] }` — each exports `(config) => config | Promise<config>`.
- `--emit-stats` → `release/webpack-stats/<project>.stats.json`.
- Accessor properties (for other heft plugins via `requestAccessToPluginByName('@microsoft/spfx-heft-plugins', …)`): `linkedExternalsToBundle`, `disableAsyncComponentLoading`, `assetsAreVersioned`, `generateCssClassName`, `cssModuleRuleTest`, `loadThemedStylesImportPath`, `buildSourceMaps`, `releaseMapFiles`, `getLocalization`, `_moduleMinifier`, …
